jobs.description:
Description

Posting Title:
Procurement Data Analyst

Reports To:
Director, Procurement

Location:
Des Moines, IA | San Jose, CA | Remote

Salary Range:
$67,500- $128,000

Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.

Who We Are

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

THE PURCHASING TEAM

The purchasing team manages all equipment and materials purchases for both job sites and corporate expenditures. This includes vetting vendors and establishing and maintaining relationships with new and loyal suppliers

About The Role

The Procurement Data Analyst is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and effectiveness of procurement and asset-related data to support operational efficiency and informed business decisions. This role serves as a key steward of procurement master data, including item master records, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement system information. The position analyzes data trends, develops reports and dashboards, supports vendor pricing and point-of-sale data management, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve processes, enhance system capabilities, and support automation initiatives. Working with general direction, the Procurement Data Analyst independently manages assigned data domains, investigates issues, recommends solutions, and collaborates with stakeholders to implement improvements.

Serve as a steward of procurement master data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency across key datasets, including the Item Master, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement systems.
Maintain the Item Master throughout its lifecycle, including new item creation, standardization, updates, and data cleanup to support consistent use across the organization.
Analyze procurement and asset-related data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, supporting process optimization and informed decision-making.
Coordinate vendor pricing updates, including weekly pricing maintenance and the collection of monthly or quarterly point-of-sale (POS) data, ensuring timely and accurate data availability.
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, streamline processes, enhance system functionality, and support automation initiatives. Conduct analyses of equipment categories and project mobilizations to support buy-versus-rent decisions.
Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that track procurement metrics, supplier performance, and system effectiveness, ensuring insights are accurate, actionable, and aligned with business objectives.
Partner with procurement leadership and IT teams in evaluating and implementing system enhancements and automation opportunities that improve efficiency and data integrity.
Independently manage assigned responsibilities, exercising sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate alternatives, recommend solutions, and drive issues through resolution.
Participate in testing, validation, and implementation of system enhancements and updates, working with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment and minimal operational disruption.
Create and maintain documentation for data structures, business processes, reporting, and system procedures to promote standardization and knowledge sharing.

About You

Knowledge of master data management principles, and supply chain data concepts, including item master, vendor, pricing, and asset/equipment data.
Knowledge of data governance practices, data quality standards, and methods for maintaining accurate and consistent business data.
Skill in analyzing and interpreting procurement, asset, and operational data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Skill in developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using reporting and data visualization tools.
Skill in using enterprise systems and databases (e.g., ERP, procurement, inventory, or asset management systems) to maintain and analyze data.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate recurring data maintenance activities, and meet established deadlines with a high degree of accuracy.
Ability to collaborate effectively with procurement, operations, finance, IT, suppliers, and other stakeholders to resolve data and process issues.
Ability to identify root causes of data discrepancies, evaluate solutions, and make sound recommendations based on analysis.
Ability to document business processes, data standards, and system procedures to support consistency, compliance, and knowledge sharing.
Ability to support system enhancements, testing activities, and process improvement initiatives through effective communication, organization, and attention to detail.

Minimum Qualifications

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.

Licensure/Certifications: N/A

Experience

Three (3) or more years of experience in data analytics, business systems, master data management, business analysis, process improvement, or a related function.

Experience with Microsoft Power Platform strongly preferred, including Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, Power Apps, and Dataverse, with hands-on experience developing, maintaining, or troubleshooting reporting, workflows, applications, or automation solutions.

Experience working with enterprise systems and business data, including ERP, asset management, procurement, inventory, or similar platforms, is preferred.

Experience with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, procurement, construction, or other asset-heavy environments is a plus.

PLEASE NOTE:
CEI will never ask for any money or financial information from applicants during the hiring process. To learn more about "job scams" how to avoid them, click here.

CEI is a place where every single person can—and does—have an impact on the work we do and the communities we serve. Here, you can build your own story and grow to your full potential. You can collaborate and celebrate with amazing people. And you’ll go home every day knowing you helped contribute to important work that shapes people’s lives. Our commercial, data center and energy projects may be complex, but our approach is simple. We build great things and we do it with great people.

jobs.title: Land Survey Field Technician I
jobs.description:
Brief Description

Join Forest Lawn’s Architecture & Engineering team and play a hands-on role in shaping and maintaining the spaces that serve generations of families. The Field Survey Technician supports surveying, development, and construction projects across Forest Lawn’s memorial parks, helping transform field conditions and survey data into accurate information that guides the planning and development of our properties.

Working alongside experienced engineering and surveying professionals and under the direction of a Licensed Professional Land Surveyor, you’ll gain valuable experience through site surveys, construction layout, as-built documentation, field measurements, and other surveying activities. This is an opportunity to build your technical skills, work in a unique and meaningful environment, and contribute to projects that have a lasting impact across Forest Lawn’s properties.

What You'll Be Doing

Under the direction of the Licensed Professional Land Surveyor, perform daily field surveying operations around the memorial parks, including but not limited to: detailed site surveys to determine existing site conditions, construction staking, as-builting of installed features (walls, flatwork, utilities, etc.).
Operate GPS, Trimble Total stations, and Auto-levels to measure angles, distances, and elevations.
Perform field calculations and measurements.
Coordinate with office staff to input information sent and export collected field data to staff.
Keep survey vehicle supplied with appropriate survey materials.
Communicate effectively with the Licensed Professional Land Surveyor, office staff, contractors, and other personnel encountered during field operations.
Maintain accurate field notes, record measurements, and documentation.
Operate Forest Lawn vehicles, survey equipment, and other equipment in a safe and responsible manner at all times.

Requirements

Minimum of 1+ years of field surveying experience.
High school diploma or GED required.
Valid California Driver’s License, including state required levels of active auto insurance.
Certification as LSIT desired.
Experience with Trimble Total Stations.
Experience with GNSS receivers.
Degree from accredited land surveying or related program desired.
Knowledge of AutoCAD, Civil 3D desired.

Competitive Benefits

Forest Lawn takes pride in offering an excellent benefits package to our employees, which taken as a whole, leads our industry and is competitive with the benefits in just about any other industry.

Click here to learn more about our benefit offerings.

Drug Testing Policy

Prior to beginning employment, all job applicants who receive a job offer will be required to voluntarily submit to a drug screening test conducted by a laboratory designated by Forest Lawn. The drug screening method is a hair collection test that will detect the use of illegal drugs within the past 90 days. A positive drug test may result in the withdrawal of the job offer.

E-Verify Statement

Forest Lawn has registered to participate in the federal government's E-Verify program. With E-Verify we are able to confirm the employment authorization of all newly hired employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. With respect to new hires, the E-Verify process is completed in conjunction with a new hire's completion of the Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification upon commencement of employment. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates.

For up-to-date information on E-Verify, go to https://www.e-verify.gov/employees/e-verify-overview.

Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance

Forest Lawn will consider for employment all qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

Summary

Forest Lawn has always attracted unique and exceptional individuals; those who aren’t satisfied with simply building a career, but want to go home at the end of the day knowing they’ve made a profound and positive difference in people’s lives.

s

jobs.title: Senior Project Coordinator - Property & Buildings
jobs.description:
Job Description

Since 1979, WSP Property & Buildings (P&B)
has been part of shaping the building landscape along the West Coast. From industrial development to warehouses, office, retail, higher education, community colleges, K-12, and healthcare, our experience spans over 40 years. Our 250+ staff is spread strategically across six locations, including Seattle, Irvine, San Jose, Los Angeles, Riverside, and San Diego, and is committed to sustainably enhancing the built environment.

This Opportunity

WSP Property & Buildings
is seeking a Senior Project Coordinator
to join our team. The Property & Buildings Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the Project Leader and project teams with administrative duties throughout the project lifecycle. They will take a proactive role assisting the Project Leader and project teams in moving the project forward and enhancing communication with the project team and Client and promoting and facilitating integration on the project.

This position may be based in our Los Angeles, Irvine or Riverside, CA
office locations.

Your Impact

Maintaining project calendar including project schedules and publishing to project team.
Assist in preparation of any materials required for project pursuit.
Assist in preparing PSA checklist, Change Orders and other internal forms.
Tracking contracts and sub-consultant contracts for the PM.
Manage Construction Administration through Newforma for all assigned projects.
Formatting project specifications in MS Word or SpecLink
Assist in scheduling design reviews, and regular project meetings.
Attend project, and team meetings and take meeting notes. Distribute meeting notes internal and externally as required.
Assist in generating project financial management reports.
Assist in tracking invoices and project payments.
Assist in tracking scope changes and preparing add service requests to the client.
Create and maintain project document file storage within the WSP standard project directory structure.
Assist the project team in receiving, filing, distributing, processing, tracking due dates and responding to RFI’s, submittals and responses.
Provide production support for project technical staff.
Assist project teams in distributing project materials to clients and other industry partners.
Edit and format specifications, Table of Contents, Basis of Design Reports and other written materials as required.
Assist Engineers of Record in processing and filing of project status forms with Authorities Having Jurisdiction.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma or GED Required
7+ years experience
MS Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point and others.
Excellent verbal, written communication and program solving skills.
Strong computer and typing skills
Detailed-oriented and thoroughness.
Self-motivated and flexible to take on new tasks and assist teams.
Strong willingness & eager to learn
Deadline oriented, ability to track and maintain and meet multiple concurrent deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Basic REVIT skills a plus.
Working knowledge of cloud-based file sharing platforms such as SharePoint, ShareFile, Newforma, Dropbox, Box, Bluebeam etc. is an advantage.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Hourly: $31.11 - $50.10

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position within the state of Colorado, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Project Coordinator provides high-level administrative and operational support to the assigned business unit, serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders on all administrative and informational matters. Additionally, this role delivers targeted marketing and project assistance to Sales and Project Managers, while offering cross-functional backup and collaborative support to other regional offices.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Plan and execute department meetings, sales conferences, and vendor presentations as directed, including managing logistics for room bookings, catering, and virtual platforms.
Document and distribute comprehensive meeting minutes and actionable recap emails to all attendees.
Coordinate the end-to-end onboarding process for new hires in collaboration with Human Resources, ensuring first-day schedules, itineraries, and team introductions are established in advance.
Facilitate new hire technical setup by coordinating IT provisioning requests, email setup, building access key fobs, and corporate business cards.
Monitor Lead Generation platforms for upcoming bid opportunities and manage the distribution of pre-bid notifications.
Support the team by preparing prequalification packages, compiling RFP responses, and assembling bid presentation materials.
Generate and distribute financial and accounting reports for Sales and Project Managers.
Manage corporate event ticket allocations for the Construction Group.

Position Requirements (Work Experience, Skills, Licenses, Etc.)

Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build rapport across diverse departments and personalities.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills tailored for professional environments.
Robust organizational skills with a track record of managing multiple competing priorities and consistently meeting tight deadlines.
Demonstrated excellence in customer service, with a strong ability to navigate complex client issues and engineer win-win solutions.
High attention to detail with an unwavering commitment to accuracy and timely project delivery.
Deep understanding of strategies required to maximize the productivity and efficiency of construction and technical teams.
Strict adherence to data privacy protocols, with a proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with total discretion.
Ability to work extended hours or overtime as required by business demands.

Required

Education and Experience:

High School diploma or equivalent
2+ years’ experience and intermediate proficiency-level usage of MS Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, MS Project
1+ years’ experience/intermediate-level usage of desktop publishing software applications

Desired

Associate degree or higher
Experience with Adobe In-Design, Acrobat, Bluebeam Photoshop, and Illustrator
General knowledge of the construction or service business

ACCO Competencies

Proactivity/Initiative: Recognizes what needs to be done and accomplishes it in a manner appropriate for one’s level/position and with minimal supervision.
Perseverance: Shows wherewithal to fight for difficult goals despite challenges and to bounce back from adversity.
Motivation/Dedication: Commits to excellence in pursuing unselfish goals. Initiates action with collective goals, takes responsibility, and shows personal humility.
Technical Curiosity/Willingness to Learn: Interest in seeking out new experiences, knowledge, and candid feedback; demonstrating an openness to learning and change.
Insight: The ability to gather and make sense of information that suggests new possibilities.
Engagement: Shows a knack for using emotion and logic to communicate a persuasive vision and connect with people.
People Skills: Is approachable and gains the mutual trust and respect of others. Understands people’s strengths & weaknesses and actively seeks to understand other perspectives.
Communication: Fosters open, honest, candid and respectful communication. Effectively assesses, defines and communicates issues in a timely manner, both written and verbal.
Teamwork: The ability to effectively work toward common goals with others by supporting, encouraging, and sharing information in an authentic and approachable manner.
Big Picture: Understands and contributes to the organizations’ short- and long-term business strategy. On a personal level has independently developed a vision for short- and long-term career success.
Problem-Solver: Ability to identify, analyze, and solve problems in support of personnel, group, department, or organizational objectives.
Execution: Effectively takes a vision and translates into action by including the right people. Identify and remove barriers, when possible, to achieve results. Demonstrates appropriate compromise, effective time management, prioritization practices and holds team members (including themselves) accountable for their performance/conduct.
Professionalism: Respectfully observes and challenges the status quo with intent for improvement. Can take direction, accept feedback, and take full responsibility for their actions. Lead by example through positive influence and ethical leadership with consideration of the entire organization.

Job Responsibility Level

No direct reports

Travel Requirements

Travel required x-x% of the time to other office locations.

Hours

This is a non-exempt position from Monday through Friday. Work hours begin and end between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm with a one-hour break for lunch and two rest breaks. Eight hours per day is required and other occasional overtime may be necessary for business needs

Physical Demands

(The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)

Must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus.
Prolonged sitting.
Frequently required to reach with hands and arms.
Occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch.

Competitive Wages

$26.92-$33.65 per hour. Applicants, please note that actual compensation is determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location, among others. The offered wage or salary is only one aspect of an employee's total compensation.

#ACCO

About Us

Why join ACCO? ACCO Engineered Systems is one of the largest mechanical contractors in the country. Since 1934, owners and builders have selected ACCO to design, install, and maintain more than 250,000 mechanical projects. ACCO is dedicated to the design, fabrication, installation, maintenance and service of commercial and industrial HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, process piping, and building automation systems. Whether your project is a low or high-rise office building, a shopping mall, hospital, semi-conductor fabrication facility or pharmaceutical manufacturing plant…ACCO can design, build, install, and maintain a mechanical system to meet your needs.

Here at ACCO, we are a part of something bigger. Just ask our customers: California Academy of Sciences, L.A. Live, and San Francisco 49ers Stadium. While we have been around for 80+ years, we continue to grow at a dynamic pace. And we are looking for talented individuals to join our team.

What's great about working at ACCO is that we’re a big enough company to be the leader in HVAC mechanical contracting in California and the Southwest U.S., but as a 100% employee-owned ESOP, we’re a private company with a family-oriented feel. Several of our employees have worked at ACCO for twenty-five, thirty, and even over forty years! Together, the employees of ACCO are comprised of intelligent, dedicated, and entrepreneurial team members who put customers first and enjoy what they do.

ACCO IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER AA M/F/V/D.

We proudly hire U.S. Military Veterans, and those qualified are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Mapping Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible and support a healthy work-life balance through our wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days per week
in a client or Cognizant office in Bothell, WA
.

About The Role

As a Mapping Data Analyst
, you will serve as a subject-matter expert in data mining, analytics, reporting, and process improvement. You will leverage data to identify operational opportunities, improve efficiency and accuracy, accelerate model and algorithm performance, and provide actionable insights that support business decisions. This role combines analytical expertise, technical problem-solving, and operational collaboration. Success in this role comes from strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, data storytelling, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business recommendations. You will work closely with mapping operations, advanced operators, quality teams, and business stakeholders as part of the Cognizant team.

In This Role, You Will

Data Analysis & Reporting

Understand business and analytical needs, document requirements, and prioritize improvement initiatives.
Build and maintain SQL queries, scripts, dashboards, and reports to track operational performance.
Use statistical methods to analyze data and generate actionable insights.
Create meaningful visualizations and reporting solutions for stakeholders and clients.
Monitor key performance indicators and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Measure solution effectiveness through before-and-after performance metrics.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Identify opportunities to improve quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Develop recommendations and proposals based on data-driven insights.
Collaborate with Advanced Operators and cross-functional teams to test improvement hypotheses.
Support initiatives that streamline workflows and optimize business processes.
Identify and implement data quality improvements and automation opportunities.
Serve as a point of contact for data-related questions and analytical support.

Technical Solutions & Data Management

Utilize SQL, Oracle, Python, and other tools to prepare, analyze, and present data.
Apply knowledge of JSON to support data workflows, integrations, and reporting solutions.
Assist in the development and enhancement of data pipelines to improve throughput and near real-time insights.
Manage source code updates using version control best practices.
Ensure data management processes and scripts comply with established standards and best practices.
Support initiatives involving spatial data analysis when applicable.

What We’re Looking For

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.
Experience working with SQL and data visualization or reporting tools.
Knowledge of Python, Oracle, JSON, or similar technologies for data analysis and automation.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Experience with process improvement, operational analytics, or business reporting is preferred.
Knowledge of spatial or geospatial data analysis is a plus.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced operational environment.
Willingness to work onsite in Bothell, WA.

Salary & Benefits

The hourly rate for this position ranges from $19.00 – $21.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits include:

Life & Disability Insurance
Group Health, Dental & Wellness
Sick Leave
401(k) Plan and Contributions

The hourly rate, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Cognizant will only consider applicants for this position who are legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for an Experienced Geologist / Hydrogeologist for our Redmond, WA, Seattle, WA, or Portland, OR offices . Be involved in projects with our Environment, Remediation, and Water Team
and be a part of a growing organization that meets our client’s objectives and solves their challenges.

Your Impact

Provide interpretation of subsurface conditions and develop conceptual geologic models using Leapfrog Geo or Leapfrog Works by Seequent;
Analysis and interpretation of geologic and hydrogeological data and preparation of reports;
Providing technical support for geologic and hydrogeologic investigations, hydrogeologic testing, geologic and hydrogeologic visualization, analytical and numerical groundwater flow modeling, contaminated sites investigations, and development of conceptual site models;
Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients by providing technical expertise, being responsive and providing quality and cost targeted consulting services
Performing (either in a lead or supporting role) business development activities, including client contact/presentations, proposal writing, and professional society participation;
Serving as an internal technical resource to provide guidance/review to help ensure technical quality within WSP; and
Work closely with other members of the WSP Site Investigation and Remediation Team as well as the wider WSP technical community around the world in a collaborative environment
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Hydrology, or Engineering;
Minimum of one-year of experience developing geologic models and conceptual site models using Leapfrog Geo or Leapfrog Works by Seequent;
Minimum of 1 years’ experience; preferably in a consulting practice.
Strong all-around academic knowledge of physical geology and hydrogeology;
Proficiency and familiarity with soil and rock logging procedures;
Practical experience with physical geology/hydrogeology including groundwater sampling, monitoring well installation, and hydraulic conductivity testing;
Familiarity with conceptual site model development;
Strong written and verbal communication skills (including making presentations, leading discussions; technical documentation, proposal/report writing, etc.), including English fluency;
Working knowledge of Microsoft Word/Excel;
Excellent work ethic with strong organization and time management skills;
Must successfully complete and pass WSP’s Motor Vehicle screening;
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team; and
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional Engineer (PE) and/or Professional Geologist (PG);
Post-graduate degree (M.Sc., Ph.D.) in Geology, Hydrology, Engineering, or related discipline;
Familiarity with geophysical methods and interpretation of geophysical data;
Experience working with GIS-type software, digital databases, and visualization software; and
Programming experience including Python, R, and VBA.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Remote work model

Position Summary

Performs advanced geoscience technical and data science work supporting asset teams by combining

subsurface data expertise, workflow development, and advanced analytics capabilities. This role

bridges traditional geotechnical functions with modern data science to improve data quality, workflow

efficiency, and technical decision-making. This position is expected to work independently, resolve

complex technical challenges, and contribute to the development of scalable workflows and best

practices.

Responsibilities

Support Riley Permian’s geoscience and asset teams by maintaining high -quality subsurface

datasets, project databases, and technical workflows used in exploration, development, and

A&D evaluation.

Load, validate, organize, and quality-control subsurface datasets while developing repeatable

workflows that improve data accessibility, consistency, and operational efficiency.

Maintain and improve geoscience project environments, including GeoGraphix, StarSteer,

QGIS, and other subsurface interpretation or planning tools, with an emphasis on data

integrity, usability, and workflow efficiency.

Partner with geologists, engineers, and data/analytics resources to integrate subsurface,

operational, production, and commercial datasets into practical analytical workflows.

Apply data science, automation, and AI/ML techniques to improve geoscience workflows,

enhance data quality, identify subsurface trends, and support technical decision-making.

Develop data products, dashboards, analytical tools, and AI -enabled knowledge workflows

that improve technical analysis, information retrieval, and communication across asset

teams.

Identify opportunities to improve data quality, automate recurring tasks, establish workflow

standards, documentation, and best practices that support scalable geoscience operations.

Assist with preparation of technical data, exhibits, cross sections, logs, data summaries, and

presentation-quality visuals for internal asset reviews, management discussions, partner

meetings, and transaction support.

Work closely with geologists, engineers, land, business development, and management while

remaining primarily embedded with and focused on geoscience team execution.

Collaborate across teams and disciplines with a strong service mindset, clear

communication, and a practical focus on improving the speed, quality, and reliability of

geoscience work.

Skills And Competencies

Understanding of unconventional resource plays, horizontal development, landing -zone

evaluation, well performance trends, and asset-development workflows.

Ability to bridge traditional geoscience technician responsibilities with modern data science,

automation, AI/ML workflows, and emerging technologies such as GenAI, prompt engineering,

RAG, and AI-enabled technical assistants

Experience using modern analytics tools to develop dashboards, automated reports,

visualizations, and analytical solutions that support upstream decision-making.

Familiarity with industry data sources such as IHS, Enverus, regulatory databases, vendor data

rooms, and third-party technical datasets.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability

to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

Self-motivated and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to

new technologies and workflows, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-moving asset-team

environment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in geology, geoscience, engineering, data science, computer science,

information systems, or a related technical field preferred; equivalent petroleum industry

experience will be considered.

5+ years of relevant experience in geoscience technical support, subsurface data

management, geotechnical workflows, petroleum data analytics, or related oil and gas

technical roles preferred.

Strong working knowledge of subsurface datasets, including well headers, directional surveys,

formation tops, raster/vector logs, digital log curves, completion data, production data,

seismic-related data, and interpretation outputs.

Experience supporting geoscience teams using subsurface applications such as GeoGraphix,

Petra, Petrel, Kingdom, StarSteer, Techlog, or similar petroleum technical software.

Demonstrated ability to load, validate, reconcile, and maintain technical data across multiple

systems while developing practical workflows, QA/QC standards, and technical outputs that

support geoscience and engineering objectives.

Experience applying AI/ML, GenAI, automation, analytics, Python, SQL, and related

technologies to support data-driven solutions.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot data issues,

identify root causes, and recommend practical workflow improvements.

Strong knowledge of subsurface datasets, including well, log, production, completion,

seismic, and interpretation data.

Experience with petroleum software such as GeoGraphix, Petra, Petrel, Kingdom, StarSteer,

Techlog, or similar platforms.

Summary

The IDEA Data Analyst supports the Office of Institutional Data, Effectiveness, and Analytics (IDEA) by providing technical expertise in data collection, validation, analysis, reporting, visualization, and survey research to advance institutional effectiveness and data-informed decision-making. The incumbent collaborates with campus partners to develop meaningful reports, dashboards, surveys, and research that support student success, strategic planning, assessment, accreditation, and institutional accountability.

Reporting to the Director of Institutional Data, Effectiveness, and Analytics (IDEA), the Data Analyst contributes to institutional research and survey initiatives, promotes data quality and governance practices, and serves as a trusted resource for campus stakeholders.

Essential Functions

The duties and responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to:

Data Validation (10%) – Assesses the quality and accuracy of data used by IDEA and attempts to identify root causes of any inconsistencies. Collaborates with appropriate campus data stewards and custodians to resolve the concerns. Documents data definitions, business rules, and reporting processes in alignment with UCCS data governance practices. Supports efforts to maintain reliable institutional data across reporting platforms and institutional datasets.
Query Building (10%) – Creates and refines queries to retrieve accurate and current information from institutional data sources (e.g., PeopleSoft/Campus Solutions, CU Central Information Warehouse, Slate, Qualtrics) for use in reports, visualizations, survey administration, research, and analysis.
Report Generation and Data Visualization (20%) – Designs, develops, and maintains interactive Tableau dashboards, reports, and visualizations that communicate institutional performance and support data-informed decision-making. Collaborates with stakeholders across Academic Affairs, Student Success, Administration, and other campus units to develop reports that address planning, assessment, accreditation, and operational needs. Assists in maintaining scalable reporting solutions that provide timely, accurate, and actionable information to internal and external stakeholders.
Survey Development, Administration, and Analysis (30%) – Serves as the primary administrator for institutional surveys managed by IDEA and supports the development, administration, analysis, and reporting of institutional surveys including NSSE and custom campus surveys. Uses Qualtrics to design, manage, and deploy surveys. Analyzes quantitative and qualitative results, produces reports, visualizations, summaries, and presentations that clearly communicate survey findings for institutional planning, assessment, accreditation, and student success initiatives.
Faculty Course Questionnaire (FCQ) Administration (30%) – Serves as the primary administrator for the Watermark Faculty Course Questionnaire (FCQ) system, managing term setup, course, instructor, and student data imports, survey scheduling, communications, and troubleshooting. Collaborates with the Faculty Resource Center on LMS/Canvas integration, the Office of Information Technology, the Office of Faculty Affairs, and other campus stakeholders to maintain and improve FCQ processes, documentation, and recommend workflow enhancements that improve efficiency, data quality, student experience and response rates.

Why GM Financial?

Responsibilities

About the role

The Data Analyst II
is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to support business performance, portfolio management, and strategic decision-making within Fleet Solutions. This role leverages advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, mitigate operational and financial risks, improve data quality, and uncover opportunities to enhance fleet utilization, vehicle lifecycle management, customer experience, and profitability.

The analyst partners closely with cross-functional teams, including Fleet Operations, Servicing, Finance, Sales, Customer Experience, and IT, to develop scalable data solutions, automate reporting processes, and deliver actionable business intelligence. The position is responsible for transforming complex data into meaningful insights through dashboards, visualizations, and performance reporting that support both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives.

This role may also contribute to forecasting, predictive modeling, and scenario analysis efforts related to vehicle demand, maintenance trends, asset utilization, remarketing performance, and operational efficiency. The Data Analyst II serves as a trusted business partner, providing analytical expertise and recommendations that drive informed decisions, support continuous improvement, and help achieve Fleet Solutions' operational and financial objectives

In This Role You Will

Develop, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that provide actionable business insights and support operational and strategic decision-making.
Partner with business stakeholders, IT, and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, translate them into analytical solutions, and deliver high-quality reporting products.
Perform complex data analysis using multiple structured and unstructured data sources to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and process improvement recommendations.
Validate data accuracy, investigate data quality issues, and collaborate with technical teams to resolve inconsistencies while improving long-term data integrity.
Create and maintain meaningful business metrics, KPIs, and documentation to support portfolio performance monitoring and operational reporting.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to business partners and leadership using clear visualizations and concise business storytelling.
Contribute to the design, enhancement, and automation of reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and data accessibility.
Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to junior analysts while promoting analytics best practices, documentation standards, and continuous improvement.

Leverage Power BI and Databricks to build, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports that clearly communicate business performance, trends, risks, and opportunities to operational and senior leadership audiences.
Use Databricks to explore, query, transform, and validate large datasets from multiple sources, producing reliable analytical datasets for reporting and decision support.
Write and troubleshoot SQL to extract, join, aggregate, and reconcile complex data while ensuring results are accurate, complete, and aligned with defined business rules.
Develop effective Power BI data models, including relationships, calculated columns, measures, and reusable DAX logic that supports consistent and scalable reporting.
Translate business questions into clearly defined metrics, KPIs, analytical requirements, and reporting solutions, challenging vague or incomplete requests when necessary.
Apply data visualization and dashboard design best practices to create reports that are intuitive, focused, and actionable rather than simply displaying available data.
Investigate data discrepancies by tracing issues through source systems, Databricks datasets, transformation logic, and Power BI models, then partner with IT and business teams to resolve root causes.
Analyze portfolio and operational data to identify meaningful trends, performance drivers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities, then convert findings into practical recommendations.
Validate reports and analytical outputs through data reconciliation, reasonableness testing, peer review, and documented quality-control processes before delivery to stakeholders.
Communicate complex analytical findings in clear business language through written summaries, presentations, and stakeholder discussions, tailoring the level of detail to the audience.
Manage multiple reporting and analytical priorities by clarifying scope, estimating effort, documenting dependencies, and communicating risks or delays before deadlines are missed.
Create and maintain documentation for business definitions, data sources, transformation logic, Power BI measures, report functionality, and recurring processes so solutions can be supported and reused by others.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Why GM Financial?

GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses

At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes new ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive

Our Purpose:
 We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters

This position will be posted until filled

Responsibilities

About the role

The Data Analyst II
is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to support business performance, portfolio management, and strategic decision-making within Fleet Solutions. This role leverages advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, mitigate operational and financial risks, improve data quality, and uncover opportunities to enhance fleet utilization, vehicle lifecycle management, customer experience, and profitability.

The analyst partners closely with cross-functional teams, including Fleet Operations, Servicing, Finance, Sales, Customer Experience, and IT, to develop scalable data solutions, automate reporting processes, and deliver actionable business intelligence. The position is responsible for transforming complex data into meaningful insights through dashboards, visualizations, and performance reporting that support both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives.

This role may also contribute to forecasting, predictive modeling, and scenario analysis efforts related to vehicle demand, maintenance trends, asset utilization, remarketing performance, and operational efficiency. The Data Analyst II serves as a trusted business partner, providing analytical expertise and recommendations that drive informed decisions, support continuous improvement, and help achieve Fleet Solutions' operational and financial objectives

In This Role You Will

Develop, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that provide actionable business insights and support operational and strategic decision-making.
Partner with business stakeholders, IT, and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, translate them into analytical solutions, and deliver high-quality reporting products.
Perform complex data analysis using multiple structured and unstructured data sources to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and process improvement recommendations.
Validate data accuracy, investigate data quality issues, and collaborate with technical teams to resolve inconsistencies while improving long-term data integrity.
Create and maintain meaningful business metrics, KPIs, and documentation to support portfolio performance monitoring and operational reporting.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to business partners and leadership using clear visualizations and concise business storytelling.
Contribute to the design, enhancement, and automation of reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and data accessibility.
Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to junior analysts while promoting analytics best practices, documentation standards, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

What makes You an ideal candidate?

Leverage Power BI and Databricks to build, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports that clearly communicate business performance, trends, risks, and opportunities to operational and senior leadership audiences.
Use Databricks to explore, query, transform, and validate large datasets from multiple sources, producing reliable analytical datasets for reporting and decision support.
Write and troubleshoot SQL to extract, join, aggregate, and reconcile complex data while ensuring results are accurate, complete, and aligned with defined business rules.
Develop effective Power BI data models, including relationships, calculated columns, measures, and reusable DAX logic that supports consistent and scalable reporting.
Translate business questions into clearly defined metrics, KPIs, analytical requirements, and reporting solutions, challenging vague or incomplete requests when necessary.
Apply data visualization and dashboard design best practices to create reports that are intuitive, focused, and actionable rather than simply displaying available data.
Investigate data discrepancies by tracing issues through source systems, Databricks datasets, transformation logic, and Power BI models, then partner with IT and business teams to resolve root causes.
Analyze portfolio and operational data to identify meaningful trends, performance drivers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities, then convert findings into practical recommendations.
Validate reports and analytical outputs through data reconciliation, reasonableness testing, peer review, and documented quality-control processes before delivery to stakeholders.
Communicate complex analytical findings in clear business language through written summaries, presentations, and stakeholder discussions, tailoring the level of detail to the audience.
Manage multiple reporting and analytical priorities by clarifying scope, estimating effort, documenting dependencies, and communicating risks or delays before deadlines are missed.
Create and maintain documentation for business definitions, data sources, transformation logic, Power BI measures, report functionality, and recurring processes so solutions can be supported and reused by others.
Partner effectively with business stakeholders, IT teams, data engineers, and other analysts to move work from initial request through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and ongoing support.
Demonstrate working knowledge of consumer finance, lending, leasing, portfolio performance, or related financial-services concepts, and apply that knowledge when interpreting data and evaluating business impact.
Support less experienced analysts by reviewing work, sharing Power BI and Databricks best practices, explaining analytical approaches, and helping troubleshoot data or reporting issues.

Work Experience & Education

2-4 years of data mining and query tool experience Req
2-4 years experience auto finance Pref
2-4 years of experience in similar role Req
Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, other quantitative field or equivalent work experience Required
Master’s Degree in Economics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics or other quantitative field Preferred

Generous benefits package available on day one to include: 401K matching, bonding leave for new parents (12 weeks, 100% paid), tuition assistance, training, GM employee auto discount, community service pay and nine company holidays.

Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation:
Competitive pay and bonus eligibility.

Hybrid work environment, 2-days a week in office.

The California Department of Social Services (CDSS) launched the Research, Automation and Data Division (RADD) to build a sustainable data culture and maximize the full value of CDSS data assets. RADD is responsible for working with Information Services (technology) and Program partners throughout the data life cycle to ensure best practices are elevated toward the goal of serving California's most vulnerable families using a human-centered and data-driven approach.

About the company:
LinkSquares is a Boston-based, AI-powered CLM SaaS leader trusted by organizations like DraftKings, Manscaped, and Vivid Seats. We automate the contracting process for legal, finance, and HR teams, helping them save time, cut costs, and improve business outcomes. For more information, visit linksquares.com.
About the team:
Join our Revenue Operations organization, the central engine of our Revenue Team that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, sales execution, and AI innovation. We are a detail-oriented and financially driven team dedicated to driving long-term value and growth by transforming internal processes into strategic advantages. We prioritize a "learn and get better" mentality, where you will not only execute proven processes but actively help refine them for the next generation of LinkSquares' growth.
About the role:
As the Senior GTM Data Analyst
, you will shape how we understand and optimize our growth engine by owning the analytical truth layer across the entire revenue organization. In this high-impact role, you will function as an internal revenue economist and independent partner to the VP of Revenue Operations and GTM executives, answering three critical questions: What is happening? Why is it happening? What should we do about it?
You’ll join a collaborative team where you have the autonomy to evolve an existing foundation while building new, scalable data models, KPI architectures, and executive reporting systems that directly influence strategic decisions. Sitting at the intersection of revenue analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, and strategic decision support, this is an ideal role for a strategic thinker who enjoys the balance of technical depth, commercial judgment, and hands-on execution.
Responsibilities:

Serve as an independent analytical partner to GTM leadership, analyzing performance across the full customer lifecycle (pipeline creation, conversion, bookings, retention, expansion, and churn) to surface emerging trends, quantify business impact, and recommend strategic actions.
KPI Architecture & Dashboards: Own the Revenue organization's KPI architecture, metric definitions, and calculation logic across Sales, CX, Marketing, Product, and Finance. Rationalize reporting, reduce dashboard sprawl, and create trusted, scalable reporting.
Planning & Scenario Analytics: Develop models that support revenue planning, pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, push/slip, and productivity analysis. Model upside/downside scenarios and leading indicators of risk to improve organizational predictability.
Executive & Board Support: Own the analytical development of recurring executive and Board reporting, ensuring outputs are grounded in reconciled metrics, consistent business logic, and clear, decision-ready frameworks.
Data Modeling & Architecture: Own, build, and optimize durable transformation and semantic models across the modern data stack for core GTM concepts (accounts, pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention, expansion, churn, and customer lifecycle) while ensuring data quality and lineage.
Analytics Innovation & AI: Leverage AI tools and automation to accelerate analytical workflows, investigation, documentation, quality assurance, and insight generation while establishing responsible AI governance and patterns.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Product, and Finance to challenge assumptions, guide roadmap prioritization, and act as a trusted advisor on major GTM decisions.

Requirements:

B2B SaaS Experience: 6+ years supporting a B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business, with deep fluency in SaaS/GTM economics, unit economics, and full customer lifecycle analysis across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience.
Technical & Modeling Depth: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Looker (or comparable BI tool), Git, semantic-layer design, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality monitoring, alongside strong familiarity with Salesforce and GTM data structures.
AI Integration: Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, documentation, automation, and insight generation, with a strong ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs against governed data.
Analytical & Commercial Mindset: Experience building and governing enterprise KPI frameworks, pipeline/forecasting models, and executive/Board reporting with the ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable commercial insights.
Collaborative Leadership: A track record of working across departments (Operations, Finance, Sales, CX, Product) to align on metric definitions, establish single-source-of-truth frameworks, and drive consensus.
Adaptability & Rigor: High standard of intellectual independence and curiosity, with the ability to bring clear recommendations—not just data—in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

We don’t just help our clients manage 340B — we simplify it and drive to deliver. SunRx was founded in 2006 with a single mission: to transform our client’s experiences and financial outcomes through relentless pursuit of knowledge and innovative healthcare services to help our clients focus on what matters most to you — improving care and medication access for low-income, rural, and vulnerable patients.

Summary

Job Description

The Data Analyst supports the delivery of service to customers by ensuring the timely and accurate deployment of routine data files. Accountabilities include data file management responsibilities such as transmission of electronic records, as well as the intake, analysis, quality control, and loading of external data files from clients & business partners.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Administers and enforces IT standards, processes and policies;
Acts as a subject matter expert when called upon and when representing the department;
Provides guidance and mentoring to less experienced Data Analysts;
Promotes continuous improvement by ensuring adherence to quality principles. Seeks out and actively participates in business initiatives that contribute to service excellence;
Performs complex data analysis in support of ad-hoc and internal and external customer requests;
Works with internal and external customers to understand analysis and reporting needs;
Develops reports and data extracts of high levels of complexity from multiple source systems and data warehouse databases;
Performs data analysis across multiple databases in order to make recommendations for client-specific problem solving;
Delivers data products in report/ presentation format, or verbally, to customer specifications and timelines;
Develops appropriate methodologies for collecting, analyzing, and presenting data;
Uses and support database applications and analytical tools. Evaluates data quality, applications, and functions, produce output, maintain operation;
Researches new data sources and analytical tools; contributes to new product development and improvement in product delivery and presentation;
Provides input and support to Business Analysts in the development of client-facing standard reports and reporting tools;
Performs frequent analysis of company data in order to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in company or client profit, patient utilization, and other items that will assist the Senior Management Team in making decisions that will grow the company.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No supervisory responsibilities

Client Responsibilities

This is an internal and external client facing position that requires excellent customer service skills and interpersonal communication skills (listening/verbal/written). One must be able to; manage difficult or emotional client situations; Respond promptly to client needs; Solicit client feedback to improve service; Respond to requests for service and assistance from clients; Meet commitments to clients.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education And/or Experience

BS/BA and 4+ years’ experience or equivalent combination of education and experience

Computer Skills

Demonstrated experience using MS SQL queries, stored procedure and maintenance
MS Excel experience required
Business Intelligence (BI) tools expertise required
Azure code base management
Healthcare (pharmacy data) experience required

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

None Required

Other Skills And Abilities

Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group, executives, managers, and subject matter experts.
Demonstrated ability to handle functional problems and difficult analytical tasks.
Ability to effectively work well within a team
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
Takes input from supervisor and appropriately and accurately applies comments/feedback
Accurately employs our methodology and documentation tools
Establishes responsible deadlines and personal work plans and manages time effectively
Must work at a very high level of accuracy

Reasoning Ability

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Language Skills

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to draft routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

Competencies
To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Composure
Decision Quality
Organizational Agility
Problem Solving
Customer Focus
Drive for Results
Peer Relations
Time Management
Dealing with Ambiguity
Learning on the Fly
Political Savvy

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Ability to maintain clear near visual acuity at approximately 20 inches or less (i.e., “close vision”) to accurately read fine print, view computer screens, and handle small objects. Requires adequate color vision and depth perception to support safety and precision in detail-oriented tasks.

Work
Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position may regularly be exposed to or encounter moving mechanical parts, high, precarious places, fumes, or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, outdoor weather conditions, risk of electrical shock or vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate (examples: business office with computers and printers, light traffic).

Work Location

This position works from a remote location. Must provide adequate support to internal clients; be available for regular interactions and coordination of work with other employees, colleagues, clients, or vendors; as well as be available to facilitate effective decisions through collaboration with stakeholders.

Working Hours

This is an exempt level position requiring the incumbent to work the hours required to fully accomplish job responsibilities and meet deadlines for work deliverables. The individual must have the flexibility to work beyond traditional hours and be able to work nights, weekends or on holidays as required. Work hours may be changed from time to time to meet the needs of the business. Typical core business hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm.

Travel

jobs.title: Right-of-Way Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
What We're Looking For

At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.

This role serves as the administrative backbone of right-of-way projects by ensuring accurate records, effective communication, and timely coordination of all project activities.

This opportunity entails providing administrative, operational, and project support for right-of-way acquisition and infrastructure development projects, supporting project and client staff by performing a variety of right-of-way project-related coordination. The coordinator will maintain discipline-specific progress tracking to help client meet milestone goals, prepare, review for completeness and accuracy, and process project-related correspondence, reports, agreements, and documentation, and maintain client database systems with project data. Coordinates tasks and works closely with the project team to assist in multiple disciplines across the right-of-way projects and may on occasion perform site visits and field/respond to inquiries from the public. The coordinator may assist with administrative project functions throughout the project lifecycle from discovery and planning to delivery and close out phases.

What You’ll Do

Prepares and maintains project plans, tracks project progress, and prepares reports for clients or project stakeholders including evaluation scores, and deliverable tracking of submittals and reviews. Monitors and evaluates project timeline and activity and delivers updates to protect team.
Assists in the management, maintenance, and distribution of project schedules in applicable software.
Monitors, tracks, and files large amounts of project documentation. Uploads and downloads deliverable documents to and from client systems. Copies and/or scans project-related documents and coordinates the distribution to internal and external stakeholders.
Supports the project and/or office quality plan and quality management system by documenting the performance of management and quality control reviews. Generates and updates the relevant QA/QC documentation and assists with the development and maintenance of the project filing structure.
Coordinates project meetings including calendar scheduling, preparing or creating materials, publishing minutes, and maintaining documentation.
Communicates basic issues, problems, or additional information to project managers and project stakeholders.
Performs other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s Degree, or
Associate’s degree and 2 years of relevant experience, or
In lieu of education, 4 years of relevant experience

What We Prefer

Experience supporting right-of-way, utility, energy, telecommunications, transportation, or construction projects
Familiarity with easements, title research, permitting, land acquisition, or property records.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work both collaboratively and independently
Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work appropriately

Who We Are

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

THE PURCHASING TEAM

The purchasing team manages all equipment and materials purchases for both job sites and corporate expenditures. This includes vetting vendors and establishing and maintaining relationships with new and loyal suppliers

About The Role

The Procurement Data Analyst is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and effectiveness of procurement and asset-related data to support operational efficiency and informed business decisions. This role serves as a key steward of procurement master data, including item master records, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement system information. The position analyzes data trends, develops reports and dashboards, supports vendor pricing and point-of-sale data management, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve processes, enhance system capabilities, and support automation initiatives. Working with general direction, the Procurement Data Analyst independently manages assigned data domains, investigates issues, recommends solutions, and collaborates with stakeholders to implement improvements.

Serve as a steward of procurement master data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency across key datasets, including the Item Master, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement systems.
Maintain the Item Master throughout its lifecycle, including new item creation, standardization, updates, and data cleanup to support consistent use across the organization.
Analyze procurement and asset-related data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, supporting process optimization and informed decision-making.
Coordinate vendor pricing updates, including weekly pricing maintenance and the collection of monthly or quarterly point-of-sale (POS) data, ensuring timely and accurate data availability.
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, streamline processes, enhance system functionality, and support automation initiatives. Conduct analyses of equipment categories and project mobilizations to support buy-versus-rent decisions.
Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that track procurement metrics, supplier performance, and system effectiveness, ensuring insights are accurate, actionable, and aligned with business objectives.
Partner with procurement leadership and IT teams in evaluating and implementing system enhancements and automation opportunities that improve efficiency and data integrity.
Independently manage assigned responsibilities, exercising sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate alternatives, recommend solutions, and drive issues through resolution.
Participate in testing, validation, and implementation of system enhancements and updates, working with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment and minimal operational disruption.
Create and maintain documentation for data structures, business processes, reporting, and system procedures to promote standardization and knowledge sharing.

About You

Knowledge of master data management principles, and supply chain data concepts, including item master, vendor, pricing, and asset/equipment data.
Knowledge of data governance practices, data quality standards, and methods for maintaining accurate and consistent business data.
Skill in analyzing and interpreting procurement, asset, and operational data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Skill in developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using reporting and data visualization tools.
Skill in using enterprise systems and databases (e.g., ERP, procurement, inventory, or asset management systems) to maintain and analyze data.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate recurring data maintenance activities, and meet established deadlines with a high degree of accuracy.
Ability to collaborate effectively with procurement, operations, finance, IT, suppliers, and other stakeholders to resolve data and process issues.
Ability to identify root causes of data discrepancies, evaluate solutions, and make sound recommendations based on analysis.
Ability to document business processes, data standards, and system procedures to support consistency, compliance, and knowledge sharing.
Ability to support system enhancements, testing activities, and process improvement initiatives through effective communication, organization, and attention to detail.

Minimum Qualifications

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.

Licensure/Certifications: N/A

Experience

Three (3) or more years of experience in data analytics, business systems, master data management, business analysis, process improvement, or a related function.

Experience with Microsoft Power Platform strongly preferred, including Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, Power Apps, and Dataverse, with hands-on experience developing, maintaining, or troubleshooting reporting, workflows, applications, or automation solutions.

Experience working with enterprise systems and business data, including ERP, asset management, procurement, inventory, or similar platforms, is preferred.

Experience with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, procurement, construction, or other asset-heavy environments is a plus.
