new_jobs.title: Consumer Research Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Description and Duties

Interested in digging into why people do what they do? Like to work independently but with a supportive team to bounce ideas off of and learn from? Want to actually see the value you add to a business? The Business Planning & Research Unit at the California Lottery is dedicated to maximizing sales and contributions to California public schools through thoughtful evaluations of marketing initiatives and enterprise programs, and conducting consumer research and analytics to drive key business and marketing strategy decisions. And we need another creative, analytical thinker to join our team!

This position requires a current Research Data Analyst I exam. If you need to take the exam or if your score has expired, click here to gain list eligibility.

This position is headquartered in Sacramento and is eligible for a hybrid telework schedule. Employees must be able to report to their assigned headquarters office as assigned. Travel expense to and from the assigned headquarters are the responsibility of the employee. Eligibility for telework requires the employee to reside in California per California Government Code Section 14200 which states: “telecommuting means the partial or total substitution of computers or telecommunication technologies, or both, for the commute to work by employees residing in California.

When choosing a state organization to work for, there are a lot of options. Why choose the California State Lottery?

People are drawn to the Lottery because we:

Are an energetic, creative, and talented team
Value diversity and inclusion in the workplace
Empower team members to bring their knowledge, expertise, and innovation
Recognize individual and team contributions
Support the importance of work-life balance
Invest in the professional development of our team members
Are dedicated to preserving our environment by lowering our carbon footprint

You will find additional information about the job in the Duty Statement
.

Working Condition
s

a. Schedule: The RDAI is expected to primarily work between the business hours of 7:30am-5:30pm.
b. Travel: Periodic travel may be required dependent on research needs.
c. Other: Required to work a minimum of two days in the headquarters office (climate controlled high-rise office building under artificial lighting).

Desirable Qualifications

In addition to evaluating each candidate's relative ability, as demonstrated by quality and breadth of experience, the following factors will provide the basis for competitively evaluating each candidate:
Degree in statistics, economics, data analysis, quantitative research, or psychology.
Knowledge and experience conducting quantitative analysis on programs or initiatives.
Knowledge and experience with the design and execution of both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies.
Knowledge and/or experience conducting data manipulation, aggregations, and analysis of structured and unstructured data using Excel.
Experience using SPSS (or other statistical software), Power BI (or other visualization tool), R (or other predictive modeling software), and/or survey data analysis software.
Knowledge of utilizing the scientific method for research.
Knowledge of time management and organizational techniques to provide for efficient prioritization and completion of competing work assignments.
Experience writing technical reports and presenting data and statistical analysis to others.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to convey and explain complex problems and solutions to a technical and non-technical audience.

Required Application Package Documents

The Following Items Are Required To Be Submitted With Your Application. Applicants Who Do Not Submit The Required Items Timely May Not Be Considered For This Job:
Current version of the State Examination/Employment Application STD Form 678 (when not applying electronically), or the Electronic State Employment Application through your Applicant Account at www.CalCareers.ca.gov. All Experience and Education relating to the Minimum Qualifications listed on the Classification Specification should be included to demonstrate how you meet the Minimum Qualifications for the position.
Resume is optional. It may be included, but is not required.
Statement of Qualifications - Please see Statement of Qualification instructions below.

new_jobs.description:
About The Role

The Capital Project Coordinator’s primaryresponsibility is to represent CBRE/Turner & Townsend by working with theProject Manager to successfully and safely deliver a project to our clients ina manner that exceeds their expectations.

What You'll Do

Issue, monitor, and control CBRE/Turner & Townsend and client specific work permits which ensure daily work initiatives are delivered in a manner aligned with all local policies and procedures.
Ensure all projects are carried out in a manner consistent with our CBRE/Turner & Townsend Zero Incident safety culture.
Monitor work activities throughout the workday on your assigned projects and ensure work activities are being carried out in a manner consistent with the published work permit(s).
Work closely with the project team and client representatives, including fire marshal, to ensure project material is properly stowed in acceptable laydown areas.
Work closely with the Project Manager and carry out a Facility Protection Plan to minimize impact of construction activities within occupied areas of a building.
Ensure direct, indirect, and / or outsourced service providers and vendors provide consistent, high-quality services.
Maintain healthy relationships with external consultants and vendors while holding them accountable in delivering their scope of work in a timely and consistent fashion.
Possess a strong ability to multitask while supporting numerous projects at any given time.
Regularly provide informal updates and formal reports to the Project Coordinator Team Lead as it relates to hours worked, number of permits issued, and safety events for your projects.
Possess the ability to solve advanced problems resulting from complex situations.
Position requires some overtime and weekend work.

Preferred Qualifications

Experiencein Building Management Systems (Metasys)
Experiencein Electrical Building Systems (120v-480v)
Experiencein Mechanical Building Systems (AHU, Exhaust Fans, Etc.)
Experiencein Plumbing Building Systems (HHW, DI water, Domestic water, Etc.)
Experiencein Steam Building Systems (Clean Steam Generators, Steam provided heat, Etc.)
Experiencein Research Lab Protocol
Experiencein Customer Service
Experiencein Gensuite or similar software
Experiencein Construction or Construction Management
Osha10 or 30 Certified

Disclaimer

Please be advised that effective January 1, 2025, CBRE Project Management and Turner & Townsend will be consolidated into a single global business entity. As a candidate applying for a position, you should be aware that while your initial employment may be with CBRE Project Management, you will subsequently transfer to the newly formed entity that encompasses both organizations.

Turner and Townsend carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for this position is $75,000 annually and the maximum salary for this position is $90,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance.

Candidate Accommodations: CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. new_jobs.title: Senior Project Coordinator - Property & Buildings
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Since 1979, WSP Property & Buildings (P&B)
has been part of shaping the building landscape along the West Coast. From industrial development to warehouses, office, retail, higher education, community colleges, K-12, and healthcare, our experience spans over 40 years. Our 250+ staff is spread strategically across six locations, including Seattle, Irvine, San Jose, Los Angeles, Riverside, and San Diego, and is committed to sustainably enhancing the built environment.

This Opportunity

WSP Property & Buildings
is seeking a Senior Project Coordinator
to join our team. The Property & Buildings Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the Project Leader and project teams with administrative duties throughout the project lifecycle. They will take a proactive role assisting the Project Leader and project teams in moving the project forward and enhancing communication with the project team and Client and promoting and facilitating integration on the project.

This position may be based in our Los Angeles, Irvine or Riverside, CA
office locations.

Your Impact

Maintaining project calendar including project schedules and publishing to project team.
Assist in preparation of any materials required for project pursuit.
Assist in preparing PSA checklist, Change Orders and other internal forms.
Tracking contracts and sub-consultant contracts for the PM.
Manage Construction Administration through Newforma for all assigned projects.
Formatting project specifications in MS Word or SpecLink
Assist in scheduling design reviews, and regular project meetings.
Attend project, and team meetings and take meeting notes. Distribute meeting notes internal and externally as required.
Assist in generating project financial management reports.
Assist in tracking invoices and project payments.
Assist in tracking scope changes and preparing add service requests to the client.
Create and maintain project document file storage within the WSP standard project directory structure.
Assist the project team in receiving, filing, distributing, processing, tracking due dates and responding to RFI’s, submittals and responses.
Provide production support for project technical staff.
Assist project teams in distributing project materials to clients and other industry partners.
Edit and format specifications, Table of Contents, Basis of Design Reports and other written materials as required.
Assist Engineers of Record in processing and filing of project status forms with Authorities Having Jurisdiction.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma or GED Required
7+ years experience
MS Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point and others.
Excellent verbal, written communication and program solving skills.
Strong computer and typing skills
Detailed-oriented and thoroughness.
Self-motivated and flexible to take on new tasks and assist teams.
Strong willingness & eager to learn
Deadline oriented, ability to track and maintain and meet multiple concurrent deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Basic REVIT skills a plus.
Working knowledge of cloud-based file sharing platforms such as SharePoint, ShareFile, Newforma, Dropbox, Box, Bluebeam etc. is an advantage.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Hourly: $31.11 - $50.10

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position within the state of Colorado, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Project Coordinator provides high-level administrative and operational support to the assigned business unit, serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders on all administrative and informational matters. Additionally, this role delivers targeted marketing and project assistance to Sales and Project Managers, while offering cross-functional backup and collaborative support to other regional offices.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Plan and execute department meetings, sales conferences, and vendor presentations as directed, including managing logistics for room bookings, catering, and virtual platforms.
Document and distribute comprehensive meeting minutes and actionable recap emails to all attendees.
Coordinate the end-to-end onboarding process for new hires in collaboration with Human Resources, ensuring first-day schedules, itineraries, and team introductions are established in advance.
Facilitate new hire technical setup by coordinating IT provisioning requests, email setup, building access key fobs, and corporate business cards.
Monitor Lead Generation platforms for upcoming bid opportunities and manage the distribution of pre-bid notifications.
Support the team by preparing prequalification packages, compiling RFP responses, and assembling bid presentation materials.
Generate and distribute financial and accounting reports for Sales and Project Managers.
Manage corporate event ticket allocations for the Construction Group.

Position Requirements (Work Experience, Skills, Licenses, Etc.)

Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build rapport across diverse departments and personalities.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills tailored for professional environments.
Robust organizational skills with a track record of managing multiple competing priorities and consistently meeting tight deadlines.
Demonstrated excellence in customer service, with a strong ability to navigate complex client issues and engineer win-win solutions.
High attention to detail with an unwavering commitment to accuracy and timely project delivery.
Deep understanding of strategies required to maximize the productivity and efficiency of construction and technical teams.
Strict adherence to data privacy protocols, with a proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with total discretion.
Ability to work extended hours or overtime as required by business demands.

Required

Education and Experience:

High School diploma or equivalent
2+ years’ experience and intermediate proficiency-level usage of MS Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, MS Project
1+ years’ experience/intermediate-level usage of desktop publishing software applications

Desired

Associate degree or higher
Experience with Adobe In-Design, Acrobat, Bluebeam Photoshop, and Illustrator
General knowledge of the construction or service business

ACCO Competencies

Proactivity/Initiative: Recognizes what needs to be done and accomplishes it in a manner appropriate for one’s level/position and with minimal supervision.
Perseverance: Shows wherewithal to fight for difficult goals despite challenges and to bounce back from adversity.
Motivation/Dedication: Commits to excellence in pursuing unselfish goals. Initiates action with collective goals, takes responsibility, and shows personal humility.
Technical Curiosity/Willingness to Learn: Interest in seeking out new experiences, knowledge, and candid feedback; demonstrating an openness to learning and change.
Insight: The ability to gather and make sense of information that suggests new possibilities.
Engagement: Shows a knack for using emotion and logic to communicate a persuasive vision and connect with people.
People Skills: Is approachable and gains the mutual trust and respect of others. Understands people’s strengths & weaknesses and actively seeks to understand other perspectives.
Communication: Fosters open, honest, candid and respectful communication. Effectively assesses, defines and communicates issues in a timely manner, both written and verbal.
Teamwork: The ability to effectively work toward common goals with others by supporting, encouraging, and sharing information in an authentic and approachable manner.
Big Picture: Understands and contributes to the organizations’ short- and long-term business strategy. On a personal level has independently developed a vision for short- and long-term career success.
Problem-Solver: Ability to identify, analyze, and solve problems in support of personnel, group, department, or organizational objectives.
Execution: Effectively takes a vision and translates into action by including the right people. Identify and remove barriers, when possible, to achieve results. Demonstrates appropriate compromise, effective time management, prioritization practices and holds team members (including themselves) accountable for their performance/conduct.
Professionalism: Respectfully observes and challenges the status quo with intent for improvement. Can take direction, accept feedback, and take full responsibility for their actions. Lead by example through positive influence and ethical leadership with consideration of the entire organization.

Job Responsibility Level

No direct reports

Travel Requirements

Travel required x-x% of the time to other office locations.

Hours

This is a non-exempt position from Monday through Friday. Work hours begin and end between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm with a one-hour break for lunch and two rest breaks. Eight hours per day is required and other occasional overtime may be necessary for business needs

Physical Demands

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus.
Prolonged sitting.
Frequently required to reach with hands and arms.
Occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch.

Competitive Wages

$26.92-$33.65 per hour. Why join ACCO? ACCO Engineered Systems is one of the largest mechanical contractors in the country. Since 1934, owners and builders have selected ACCO to design, install, and maintain more than 250,000 mechanical projects. ACCO is dedicated to the design, fabrication, installation, maintenance and service of commercial and industrial HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, process piping, and building automation systems. Whether your project is a low or high-rise office building, a shopping mall, hospital, semi-conductor fabrication facility or pharmaceutical manufacturing plant…ACCO can design, build, install, and maintain a mechanical system to meet your needs.

new_jobs.description:
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible and support a healthy work-life balance through our wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days per week
in a client or Cognizant office in Bothell, WA
.

About The Role

As a Mapping Data Analyst
, you will serve as a subject-matter expert in data mining, analytics, reporting, and process improvement. You will leverage data to identify operational opportunities, improve efficiency and accuracy, accelerate model and algorithm performance, and provide actionable insights that support business decisions. This role combines analytical expertise, technical problem-solving, and operational collaboration. Success in this role comes from strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, data storytelling, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business recommendations. You will work closely with mapping operations, advanced operators, quality teams, and business stakeholders as part of the Cognizant team.

In This Role, You Will

Data Analysis & Reporting

Understand business and analytical needs, document requirements, and prioritize improvement initiatives.
Build and maintain SQL queries, scripts, dashboards, and reports to track operational performance.
Use statistical methods to analyze data and generate actionable insights.
Create meaningful visualizations and reporting solutions for stakeholders and clients.
Monitor key performance indicators and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Measure solution effectiveness through before-and-after performance metrics.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Identify opportunities to improve quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Develop recommendations and proposals based on data-driven insights.
Collaborate with Advanced Operators and cross-functional teams to test improvement hypotheses.
Support initiatives that streamline workflows and optimize business processes.
Identify and implement data quality improvements and automation opportunities.
Serve as a point of contact for data-related questions and analytical support.

Technical Solutions & Data Management

Utilize SQL, Oracle, Python, and other tools to prepare, analyze, and present data.
Apply knowledge of JSON to support data workflows, integrations, and reporting solutions.
Assist in the development and enhancement of data pipelines to improve throughput and near real-time insights.
Manage source code updates using version control best practices.
Ensure data management processes and scripts comply with established standards and best practices.
Support initiatives involving spatial data analysis when applicable.

What We’re Looking For

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.
Experience working with SQL and data visualization or reporting tools.
Knowledge of Python, Oracle, JSON, or similar technologies for data analysis and automation.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Experience with process improvement, operational analytics, or business reporting is preferred.
Knowledge of spatial or geospatial data analysis is a plus.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced operational environment.
Willingness to work onsite in Bothell, WA.

Salary & Benefits

The hourly rate for this position ranges from $19.00 – $21.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits include:

Life & Disability Insurance
Group Health, Dental & Wellness
Sick Leave
401(k) Plan and Contributions

new_jobs.title: Associate Geologist/Hydrogeologist
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for an Experienced Geologist / Hydrogeologist for our Redmond, WA, Seattle, WA, or Portland, OR offices . Be involved in projects with our Environment, Remediation, and Water Team
and be a part of a growing organization that meets our client’s objectives and solves their challenges.

Your Impact

Provide interpretation of subsurface conditions and develop conceptual geologic models using Leapfrog Geo or Leapfrog Works by Seequent;
Analysis and interpretation of geologic and hydrogeological data and preparation of reports;
Providing technical support for geologic and hydrogeologic investigations, hydrogeologic testing, geologic and hydrogeologic visualization, analytical and numerical groundwater flow modeling, contaminated sites investigations, and development of conceptual site models;
Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients by providing technical expertise, being responsive and providing quality and cost targeted consulting services
Performing (either in a lead or supporting role) business development activities, including client contact/presentations, proposal writing, and professional society participation;
Serving as an internal technical resource to provide guidance/review to help ensure technical quality within WSP; and
Work closely with other members of the WSP Site Investigation and Remediation Team as well as the wider WSP technical community around the world in a collaborative environment
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Hydrology, or Engineering;

Geoscientific Studies and Interpretations: Contribute to a broad range of water resources proposals and investigations by analyzing and interpreting geological/geophysical/hydrological field data.
Field Work and Travel: Travel and overnight stays to conduct field projects lasting in duration from 1 day to several weeks. Sometimes requiring work at remote field locations.
Data Collection and Analysis: Collate and analyze data using preset tools, methods, and formats. Involves working independently.

Mineral Reserves and Resource Assessment: Coordinate a range of complex mineral assessment operations, focusing on both quantity and quality of deposits.
Personal Capability Building: Develop own capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching; gain or maintain external professional accreditation, where relevant, to improve performance and fulfill personal potential. Maintain an understanding of relevant technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.
Project Management: Work within an established project management plan to achieve specific goals.
Simulation and Modelling: Deliver the design and execution process of increasingly complex simulations or models, ensuring accurate and relevant output.
Solutions Analysis: Interpret data and identify possible answers. Involves navigating a wide variety of processes, procedures, and precedents.

Bachelor’s Degree in Hydrology, Geology, Geoscience, or related field.

Experience

0-2 years of experience in a related field.

Job Description

Why GM Financial?

GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses

At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes new ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive

Our Purpose:
 We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters

This position will be posted until filled

Responsibilities

About the role

The Data Analyst II
is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to support business performance, portfolio management, and strategic decision-making within Fleet Solutions. This role leverages advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, mitigate operational and financial risks, improve data quality, and uncover opportunities to enhance fleet utilization, vehicle lifecycle management, customer experience, and profitability.

The analyst partners closely with cross-functional teams, including Fleet Operations, Servicing, Finance, Sales, Customer Experience, and IT, to develop scalable data solutions, automate reporting processes, and deliver actionable business intelligence. The position is responsible for transforming complex data into meaningful insights through dashboards, visualizations, and performance reporting that support both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives.

This role may also contribute to forecasting, predictive modeling, and scenario analysis efforts related to vehicle demand, maintenance trends, asset utilization, remarketing performance, and operational efficiency. The Data Analyst II serves as a trusted business partner, providing analytical expertise and recommendations that drive informed decisions, support continuous improvement, and help achieve Fleet Solutions' operational and financial objectives

In This Role You Will

Develop, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that provide actionable business insights and support operational and strategic decision-making.
Partner with business stakeholders, IT, and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, translate them into analytical solutions, and deliver high-quality reporting products.
Perform complex data analysis using multiple structured and unstructured data sources to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and process improvement recommendations.
Validate data accuracy, investigate data quality issues, and collaborate with technical teams to resolve inconsistencies while improving long-term data integrity.
Create and maintain meaningful business metrics, KPIs, and documentation to support portfolio performance monitoring and operational reporting.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to business partners and leadership using clear visualizations and concise business storytelling.
Contribute to the design, enhancement, and automation of reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and data accessibility.
Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to junior analysts while promoting analytics best practices, documentation standards, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

What makes You an ideal candidate?

Leverage Power BI and Databricks to build, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports that clearly communicate business performance, trends, risks, and opportunities to operational and senior leadership audiences.
Use Databricks to explore, query, transform, and validate large datasets from multiple sources, producing reliable analytical datasets for reporting and decision support.
Write and troubleshoot SQL to extract, join, aggregate, and reconcile complex data while ensuring results are accurate, complete, and aligned with defined business rules.
Develop effective Power BI data models, including relationships, calculated columns, measures, and reusable DAX logic that supports consistent and scalable reporting.
Translate business questions into clearly defined metrics, KPIs, analytical requirements, and reporting solutions, challenging vague or incomplete requests when necessary.
Apply data visualization and dashboard design best practices to create reports that are intuitive, focused, and actionable rather than simply displaying available data.
Investigate data discrepancies by tracing issues through source systems, Databricks datasets, transformation logic, and Power BI models, then partner with IT and business teams to resolve root causes.
Analyze portfolio and operational data to identify meaningful trends, performance drivers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities, then convert findings into practical recommendations.
Validate reports and analytical outputs through data reconciliation, reasonableness testing, peer review, and documented quality-control processes before delivery to stakeholders.
Communicate complex analytical findings in clear business language through written summaries, presentations, and stakeholder discussions, tailoring the level of detail to the audience.
Manage multiple reporting and analytical priorities by clarifying scope, estimating effort, documenting dependencies, and communicating risks or delays before deadlines are missed.
Create and maintain documentation for business definitions, data sources, transformation logic, Power BI measures, report functionality, and recurring processes so solutions can be supported and reused by others.
Partner effectively with business stakeholders, IT teams, data engineers, and other analysts to move work from initial request through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and ongoing support.
Demonstrate working knowledge of consumer finance, lending, leasing, portfolio performance, or related financial-services concepts, and apply that knowledge when interpreting data and evaluating business impact.
Support less experienced analysts by reviewing work, sharing Power BI and Databricks best practices, explaining analytical approaches, and helping troubleshoot data or reporting issues.

Work Experience & Education

2-4 years of data mining and query tool experience Req
2-4 years experience auto finance Pref
2-4 years of experience in similar role Req
Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, other quantitative field or equivalent work experience Required
Master’s Degree in Economics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics or other quantitative field Preferred

What We Offer:
Generous benefits package available on day one to include: 401K matching, bonding leave for new parents (12 weeks, 100% paid), tuition assistance, training, GM employee auto discount, community service pay and nine company holidays.

Our Culture:
Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation:
Competitive pay and bonus eligibility.

Work Life Balance:
Hybrid work environment, 2-days a week in office.

new_jobs.description:
About the company:
LinkSquares is a Boston-based, AI-powered CLM SaaS leader trusted by organizations like DraftKings, Manscaped, and Vivid Seats. We automate the contracting process for legal, finance, and HR teams, helping them save time, cut costs, and improve business outcomes. For more information, visit linksquares.com.
About the team:
Join our Revenue Operations organization, the central engine of our Revenue Team that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, sales execution, and AI innovation. We are a detail-oriented and financially driven team dedicated to driving long-term value and growth by transforming internal processes into strategic advantages. We prioritize a "learn and get better" mentality, where you will not only execute proven processes but actively help refine them for the next generation of LinkSquares' growth.
About the role:
As the Senior GTM Data Analyst
, you will shape how we understand and optimize our growth engine by owning the analytical truth layer across the entire revenue organization. In this high-impact role, you will function as an internal revenue economist and independent partner to the VP of Revenue Operations and GTM executives, answering three critical questions: What is happening? Why is it happening? What should we do about it?
You’ll join a collaborative team where you have the autonomy to evolve an existing foundation while building new, scalable data models, KPI architectures, and executive reporting systems that directly influence strategic decisions. Sitting at the intersection of revenue analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, and strategic decision support, this is an ideal role for a strategic thinker who enjoys the balance of technical depth, commercial judgment, and hands-on execution.
Responsibilities:

Serve as an independent analytical partner to GTM leadership, analyzing performance across the full customer lifecycle (pipeline creation, conversion, bookings, retention, expansion, and churn) to surface emerging trends, quantify business impact, and recommend strategic actions.
KPI Architecture & Dashboards: Own the Revenue organization's KPI architecture, metric definitions, and calculation logic across Sales, CX, Marketing, Product, and Finance. Rationalize reporting, reduce dashboard sprawl, and create trusted, scalable reporting.
Planning & Scenario Analytics: Develop models that support revenue planning, pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, push/slip, and productivity analysis. Model upside/downside scenarios and leading indicators of risk to improve organizational predictability.
Executive & Board Support: Own the analytical development of recurring executive and Board reporting, ensuring outputs are grounded in reconciled metrics, consistent business logic, and clear, decision-ready frameworks.
Data Modeling & Architecture: Own, build, and optimize durable transformation and semantic models across the modern data stack for core GTM concepts (accounts, pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention, expansion, churn, and customer lifecycle) while ensuring data quality and lineage.
Analytics Innovation & AI: Leverage AI tools and automation to accelerate analytical workflows, investigation, documentation, quality assurance, and insight generation while establishing responsible AI governance and patterns.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Product, and Finance to challenge assumptions, guide roadmap prioritization, and act as a trusted advisor on major GTM decisions.

Requirements:

B2B SaaS Experience: 6+ years supporting a B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business, with deep fluency in SaaS/GTM economics, unit economics, and full customer lifecycle analysis across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience.
Technical & Modeling Depth: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Looker (or comparable BI tool), Git, semantic-layer design, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality monitoring, alongside strong familiarity with Salesforce and GTM data structures.
AI Integration: Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, documentation, automation, and insight generation, with a strong ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs against governed data.
Analytical & Commercial Mindset: Experience building and governing enterprise KPI frameworks, pipeline/forecasting models, and executive/Board reporting with the ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable commercial insights.
Collaborative Leadership: A track record of working across departments (Operations, Finance, Sales, CX, Product) to align on metric definitions, establish single-source-of-truth frameworks, and drive consensus.
Adaptability & Rigor: High standard of intellectual independence and curiosity, with the ability to bring clear recommendations—not just data—in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Compensation for this role includes an annual base salary range between $150,000 to $175,000. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus. LinkSquares takes into consideration a number of factors when determining an employee’s starting salary, including work location, job-related skills, and relevant education, experience and training. The recruiter assigned to this role will share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.
Candidates are eligible to participate in the company’s benefit programs. LinkSquares’ benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement plan with a company match, equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), flexible paid time off, generous parental leave, life and disability insurances and more.

new_jobs.description:
What We're Looking For

At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.

This role serves as the administrative backbone of right-of-way projects by ensuring accurate records, effective communication, and timely coordination of all project activities.

This opportunity entails providing administrative, operational, and project support for right-of-way acquisition and infrastructure development projects, supporting project and client staff by performing a variety of right-of-way project-related coordination. The coordinator will maintain discipline-specific progress tracking to help client meet milestone goals, prepare, review for completeness and accuracy, and process project-related correspondence, reports, agreements, and documentation, and maintain client database systems with project data. Coordinates tasks and works closely with the project team to assist in multiple disciplines across the right-of-way projects and may on occasion perform site visits and field/respond to inquiries from the public. The coordinator may assist with administrative project functions throughout the project lifecycle from discovery and planning to delivery and close out phases.

Communicates basic issues, problems, or additional information to project managers and project stakeholders.

new_jobs.description:
At FNBO, our employees are the heart of our story—and we’re committed to their success! Please see below the details of this career opportunity and how it fits into our organization’s success.

Summary Of The Job

As a Project Coordinator you will be an integral part of a team, facilitating Agile ceremonies, supporting the intake, planning and execution of work, and collaborating with the team to continually improve how they work. You will be accountable to help identify and resolve risks and roadblocks that get in the way of the team's success. You will also step in to lead smaller, team-driven projects — keeping work organized, dependencies on track, and meeting milestones.

About This Role

Key Accountabilities:

Organize intake requests, facilitate conversations and partner with key roles in the creation, reviews and maintaining of a team roadmap and backlog
Work with tech and business line owners to develop requirements, define success metrics, manage, and execute
Schedule and facilitate work breakdown sessions to build out epics, stories, and plan a timetable for an initiative
Ensures accurate and timely updates on execution of the team’s work and accountability to stakeholders.
Demonstrate proactive risk management through risk mitigation, appropriate escalations, driving decision making and issue resolution
Protect the team from external interruptions and distractions. Keep the team motivated while promoting a culture of transparency and accountability.
Monitor the milestones, help to remove roadblocks, to remain on schedule
Diligently update Agile tool for documentation of the work
Facilitate Agile ceremonies appropriate with the team’s make-up and organization maintaining an agile mindset
Exhibit strong leadership skills by bringing the team together and leveraging the skills of individual team members
Displays ability to shift thinking and adapt to the demands of an evolving situation to solve problems.
Monitor practices, team performance, processes, and metrics to identify opportunities for improvement

Required

The Ideal Candidate for This Role:

Bachelor’s degree in business management or related field
1-3 years’ experience managing projects or relevant business experience
Strong Agile Mindset with experience facilitating Agile ceremonies
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Proven track record of meeting deadlines
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Desired

Outstanding organizational abilities
Adaptable thinking and problem-solving
Strong leadership capabilities
Excellent facilitation skills
Detail-oriented with process improvement mindset

Candidates must possess unrestricted work authorization and not require future sponsorship.

Compensation

Compensation range (base pay): $69,616.00-$114,867.00

This role may have a specific starting pay within this range.

Final compensation offer to candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon work experience, education, and/or skill level.

Work Environment

It is anticipated that the incumbent in this role will work in a hybrid capacity, balancing in-person collaboration three (3) days a week with remote flexibility two (2) days a week. As part of our team, you'll experience the energy and relationship-building of face-to-face collaboration while still enjoying the flexibility of remote workdays. We provide the tools and technology to ensure seamless transitions between work environments, supporting your productivity wherever you are. Please note that work location is subject to change based on business needs.

Benefits Overview

We offer a variety of benefits designed to keep you and your family physically and financially healthy. Not only do we offer a competitive salary and work-life balance, we offer benefits to match your needs:

Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
401k, With Matching Contributions
Time Off Programs
Health Savings Account (HSA)/Dependent Care

Growth Opportunities

The Region Program Coordinator - partners with multiple Regional Leader teams by discerning and executing on the highest priorities.

You will provide advanced strategic support and serve as an extension to their leadership team, share ideas, resources, problem solve, plan, facilitate and act on all region related activities. You will virtually partner with multiple Regional Leadership Teams and proactively plan the execution of your region related work so the branch team can focus more time on delivering Human Centered Complete Wealth Management and growing their impact with their clients.

Using strategy and collaboration, you will partner with your regional leadership teams on advanced coordination, engagement, and event planning support.

Scheduling
Event Planning
Advanced Communications
Reporting
Research and Problem Solving
Expense Management

Ways We Work

It's very important that you balance your time, expertise, and access to resources across your 3 assigned regions’ highest priorities.
You will work to ensure that the projects are prioritized, and the work is completed from week to week, as well as forecasting future assignments.
You will be expected to communicate your capacity and reprioritize work so that all can be completed in an agreed upon timeline.
You will be expected to document role clarity on your many region-related tasks as those roles emerge over the course of your individual region relationships.
You will also document Standard Operating Procedures over the course of the first two trimesters to ensure consistency and efficiency.

Qualifications

Minimum of 3 years of advanced strategic and project coordination support, customer service experience and event management experience.
Tactical problem solving and analytical skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills with ability to multi-task and work independently.
Excellent computer skills including advanced application of Microsoft Office applications, Word, Excel, Teams, PowerPoint, as well as advanced Zoom and virtual meeting facilitation.
Accomplished at working in a fast paced, team-oriented environment, quickly learning, and applying new and complex information.

new_jobs.title: Omnify COBRA Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Position Summary
: The Omnify COBRA Program Coordinator is responsible for the administration and ongoing support of COBRA and employee benefit programs, including system configuration, employer setup and maintenance, reporting, invoicing support, compliance activities, and participant account management. This role serves as a subject matter expert on COBRA regulations, internal policies, procedures, and the Alegeus platform, partnering closely with Relationship Management, Customer Care, and Operations teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely service delivery. In addition, the Coordinator supports HSAs, FSAs, HRAs, LSAs, and DCAs and provides backup coverage for key operational functions across the team.

Essential Functions

Serve as the primary point of contact for COBRA Alegeus system inquiries, staying current on system releases and enhancements, and partnering with management to implement updates.
Assist with COBRA Alegeus initiatives, including beta testing, system configuration, and ongoing enhancements.
Execute employer setup and maintenance within Alegeus for all applicable benefit products, including COBRA, HSA, FSA, LSA, and HRA.
Execute COBRA-related employer communications, including open enrollment materials and system updates.
Generate and distribute monthly COBRA employer activity reports to support compliance with applicable regulatory requirements; prepare monthly reporting for Controllers.
Prepare, reconcile, and distribute monthly COBRA disbursements via ACH for carriers and employers.
Execute COBRA enrollment changes, updates, corrections, and terminations within the COBRA platform in accordance with regulatory guidelines.
Assist with monthly employer invoicing processes, ensuring applicable subsidies are accurately applied to invoices and providing backup support for related operational activities to maintain continuity and service standards.
Facilitate semi-annual COBRA census reporting and periodic regulatory reporting requirements.
Process COBRA-related documentation, including lockbox items, payments, and correspondence received via fax, email, or mail.
Develop, document, and maintain COBRA procedures and operational workflows for the Omnify platform.
Facilitate and serve as a contact regarding COBRA EDI file processing, collaborating with HRIS systems and benefits providers to ensure accurate and timely data exchange.
Cross-train on all Omnify operational functions and provide backup support across the Operations team as needed.
Coordinate periodic mailings and fulfillment activities related to COBRA administration.
Partner with Customer Care and Relationship Management teams to resolve system issues, research inquiries, and address operational questions.
Provide back up to Customer Care with documentation, transaction processing, and ongoing support for customer issues through phone calls and on-site visits.
Maintain working knowledge of applicable regulations, including COBRA, HIPAA, IRS Section 125, Publication 969, Publication 502, and related regulatory updates.
Understand and adhere to all bank policies, laws, and regulations applicable to their role. Complete compliance training: follow internal processes and controls as required.
Report all compliance issues, violations of law or regulations in accordance with the steps defined in bank policies.
Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of this position.
Perform other job-related duties or special projects as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field preferred.
At least 2 years of experience in human resources, employee benefits, banking, financial services, or a related field is required. An equivalent combination of experience in benefits administration and financial service operations will be considered.
Strong understanding of COBRA, HIPAA, and employee benefit products and regulations.
General accounting experience a preferred.
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office products, existing bank software preferred or demonstrated ability to learn new software quickly.
Research skills required.

Preferred Talents

Accurate and detailed
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Time efficient and deadline driven
Effective communicator
Independent with good judgement
Organized
Self-motivated and takes initiative
Customer service oriented

Working Environment

Sedentary work, occasionally lifting and/or carrying up to 20 pounds.

Indoor work with occasional travel required.

Infrequent exposure to outdoor elements or hazards.

This role is eligible for hybrid work from home opportunity under the work from home guidelines upon completion of onboarding.
